items.name: World Tree Seed
items.description: A magical seed that can be planted at seed plots to grow a World Tree. Provides respawn points, building slots, and warehouse storage for you and your guild.
items.notes: Used to claim seed plots across the world. Can also be obtained from quests and achievements.

items.name: Campfire Kit
items.description: A portable kit containing kindling, flint, and tinder. Use this to place a respawn campfire anywhere in the world.
items.notes: Allows players to create temporary respawn points. Campfires last until destroyed or replaced.
